solutionSql:
SELECT (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS booking_day,
       COUNT(*)::integer AS bookings
FROM shipments
WHERE booked_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND booked_at <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 1;

ambiguities.phrase: for days with at least two bookings
ambiguities.readingChosen: A booking is any shipment row, including cancelled shipments.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Count only non-cancelled shipments. The same 17 days remain, but the counts change (2026-01-01 becomes 8 instead of 12).

notes: Each day from 1 to 16 January has 12 shipments and 31 January has 2, so the at-least-two filter keeps all 17 days.
